verdict.rationale: Runtime probe confirms the core Phaser engine is published under the MIT license (npm registry metadata), which is inherently permissive and imposes no royalties or per-install fees, letting studios keep 100% of game revenue. The evidence pack does not include an explicit vendor statement like 'no royalties' or 'keep what you earn,' so this is inferred from the MIT designation rather than a direct claim; separately, the paid Editor/pricing page (phaser-docs-30) mentions 'full commercial rights' and license transfer for a different, optional commercial tool, not the core engine's licensing terms. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement on royalty-free/no-fee terms and independent legal/community confirmation of the license text.
